title: Evening on the Catamaran
text: Excellent excursion! Thoroughly enjoyed the new friends we made. The staff were wonderful! Highly recommend.
author: 688brandta

title: Absolutely amazing! Incredible views & wonderful hosts!
author: Debra S

title: Hang Back and Relax in a beautiful place.
text: The guitar music was wonderful. We loved the opportunity to swim in the Mediterranean Sea. The wine and tapas were great as well. We had a beautiful sunset. It was a great thing to do to relax from touring the city.
author: Vivian_K

title: Absolutely recommended, go for it!
text: We took the dinner option which was incredible! The food was amazing and the team pair it with a great local wine. All the crew were super friendly, and catered to every need, providing high class service. Thanks to the captain and crew!
author: David_S

title: Sunset Cruise on Catamaran
text:
The dinner was exceptional given that it was prepared on the catamaran by the First Mate. There were only 3 couples so you left having made new friends. She prepared a seafood paella which was filled with shrimp, clams and squid.

The Captain was very experience which showed as he navigated through the very choppy water.
author: BarbaraJ_M

title: Outstanding evening
text: The views from the boat were amazing. Our host for the cruise was wonderful, and the weather was great.
author: Carson_A

title: A different perspective...
text:
This was a fun experience to see Barcelona from the sea.  It really provided a different perspective of the city and provided a chance to see the unique skyline.

The crew was exceptional - they kept our drink glasses full, served us a great meal, all while pointing out key aspects of the city.
author: DONALD_S

title: Amazing experience
text: The experience was really beautiful, really nice views of Barcelona super friendly hosts, delicious foods & drinks. It was perfect get away for a group of friends.
author: SabinaKovalevskaja

title: Awesome experience
text: This is an activity you can't miss in Barcelona. Awesome experience, incredible crew. Looking forward to the next trip!
author: cl c

title: Awesome tour on a boat with history
text: This tour was awesome. The people are super friendly and you really feel that they want to take care you and give you an perfect experience. Don't miss out to take a tour with the boat lady, because this boat has history and she will tell you all the secrets.
author: denniscK9769YF
